name: opensourcebook-voice-kokoro
description: Kokoro, a voice that runs on this computer with no key (src/kokoro.ts). Installed only by a person who wants it: npm run voice:kokoro in services/scenes. The install fetches the model once.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "import('kokoro-js').then((k) => k.KokoroTTS.from_pretrained('onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX', { dtype: 'q8', device: 'cpu' })).then(() => console.log('Kokoro is ready. Turn it on with SCENES_VOICE=kokoro in services/scenes/.env.'))"
